activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1930 as Chandrasekhar's representative British astrophysics milestone: he left India for postgraduate study at Cambridge and, during the voyage to England, developed the insight that became the Chandrasekhar limit.

sources.title: It was written in the stars — University of Chicago Magazine
sources.citation_text: The University of Chicago records that Chandrasekhar went to England in 1930 for Cambridge postgraduate study and arrived at his Nobel-winning white-dwarf insight during the voyage.
